first_missing_criterion: canonical BUILDING_PRESENT parcel AOI plus dataset-specific confirmation of the coordinate reference system used by the Belfast City 2006 North East Zone and the real archive-internal DTM tile filenames needed to bind the intersecting tile. This unused official SpatialNI Data Supply Metadata window establishes that SpatialNI uses Irish Grid (TM65) [EPSG:29902] as a data-supply spatial reference system option, but the form is generic platform guidance rather than Belfast City 2006 dataset metadata; EPSG:29902 is therefore not attributed to the North East Zone without a dataset-specific source, and no tile filename, geometry or parcel binding is fabricated.
